DEEP LIT REVIEW DISPATCHED + IN-REPO REUSE INVENTORY (pre-planning).

**Why a lit review at all.** #2588 opens a NEW direction (capability as the
independent variable for context-to-answer map quality), so the standing rule
requires a thorough literature review plus a precise formalization before any
extraction code. The Goal already carries the formalization; this note records
the review dispatch and the reuse inventory that the planner inherits.

**Frozen question (Step 0 of the deep-lit-review protocol), verbatim:** Does the
quality of a LINEAR map from a language model's context representation (residual
state at the last prompt token) to its own answer representation (token-mean over
its generated answer) increase with the model's general capability, across models
of different families and sizes? And does chain-of-thought (taking the end-of-CoT
state as the map input) change that relationship?

Inclusion criteria: (1) fits/analyses a linear probe or map over LM internal
representations AND reports variation with scale or capability; (2) predicts a
model's own output or behavior from its pre-generation internal state, or fits a
map between two internal spaces of the same model; (3) analyses how CoT/reasoning
training changes representations, especially the end-of-reasoning state;
(4) defines or critiques a composite LM capability index; (5) supplies
cross-width comparability or under-determined-ridge estimator discipline.
Exclusion: benchmark-only papers; single-model probing with no scale axis and no
self-output-prediction framing; cross-MODEL representation alignment except where
it bears on cross-width comparability; non-LM domains except as method sources.

**Fan-out (Steps 1-3, the protocol's sanctioned scout variant).** Four scouts, one
per sub-question, each retrieval-grounded across arXiv MCP keyword + semantic,
Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, and web, each with a one-hop citation snowball and a
loop-until-dry stop rule, each budgeted so the aggregate stays inside the
protocol's discovery cap: A = linear-readout quality versus scale and capability
(explicitly including disconfirming/negative results); B = predicting a model's own
output from pre-generation state and maps between a model's own internal spaces
(tasked to surface the closest prior formalization of a context-to-answer map);
C = CoT and reasoning-training effects on representations and what the
end-of-reasoning state encodes (tasked to return where prior work takes that state,
token and layer); D = the capability axis (Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
composition, per-thinking-mode publication, validity caveats) plus cross-width
comparability of a map-quality metric. Steps 4 to 7 (screening, full-text
quote-grounded reads, synthesis, and the mandatory resolution plus
claim-versus-source verification) stay with this orchestrator. The review lands as
a markdown artifact in this task's artifacts dir and folds into the plan.
